subject: general
question:
What is the value of y in the following equation?

(1 ÷ 23) of [2{3 + 4(35 ÷ 7)}] = y
solution:
Given

(1 ÷ 23) of [2{3 + 4(35 ÷ 7)}] = y

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

⇒ (1 ÷ 23) of [2{3 + 4(35 ÷ 7)}] = y

⇒ (1 ÷ 23) of [2{3 + 4(5)}] = y

⇒ (1 ÷ 23) of [46] = y

⇒ y = 2

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
